items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I played from the 15th until the 20th of February with a big band under the leadership of Alain Romans.

ctx.x: The tour in Holland with the Dutch Swing College Band was in September and this was a real happy tour. This was the drinkingest band that I ever knew. I've heard stories about how the old Fletcher Henderson band guys could drink, but I actually saw how those cats could bend elbows. I couldn't and didn't try to out drink any of them, but I taken quite a few solos with the bottle. What was so amazing about their drinking is that they never let that ignorant oil interfere with their playing and they had a swinging…

The rest of 1957 and the first two months of 1958 I did galas, concerts in France with various groups and played in my ole stomping ground home, the Trois Mailletz. There was a five days carnival in a city called Narbonne which I played from the 15th until the 20th of February with a big band under the leadership of Alain Romans. Alain was the owner of a club on rue Colisee in Paris, not far from the Champs-Elysees and he plays piano and also has composed music for movile films. I also did some radio programmes…
